title: The Community Repair Café
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先读题，听两遍后作答。答案必须来自录音原文。
transcript:
Maya: Hi, Tom. Are you still coming to the repair café on Saturday? We need more volunteers.
Tom: I think so, but I have to check my schedule. My sister is visiting, so I might need to pick her up from the station.
Maya: That’s fine. The café runs from ten to four, so you could come for just two hours if that helps.
Tom: Good. What kind of things do people bring?
Maya: Mostly small electrical items—lamps, kettles, that sort of thing. Last month we fixed twenty-three items, and we only had to throw away four.
Tom: That’s impressive. Do you have enough tools?
Maya: We do now. A local shop donated a full set of screwdrivers and a multimeter. But we’re short of people who can sew. If you know anyone who can repair clothes, please ask them.
Tom: I’ll ask my neighbour. She’s very good with a sewing machine. By the way, is it free?
Maya: Yes, it’s completely free, although we welcome donations. We suggest two pounds per item, but nobody has to pay.
Tom: And where is it exactly?
Maya: In the community hall on Mill Road—the one next to the library. Not the church hall. People often confuse them.
Tom: Right. I went to the church hall for a meeting once. It’s easy to mix them up.
Maya: Exactly. Oh, and one more thing: if you bring your own item to repair, please label it with your name. We had a mix-up last time because two people brought identical lamps.
Tom: Good to know. So, shall I come at ten?
Maya: Actually, could you come at half past nine? We need help setting up the tables before we open.
Tom: No problem. I’ll be there at nine thirty. Do I need to bring anything?
Maya: Just yourself. We provide tea and biscuits, so you don’t need to bring snacks.
Tom: Perfect. See you Saturday.

grammar.title: 复合句与简单句搭配；条件、让步和原因表达
grammar.explanation: 英语中，简单句只有一个主谓结构，复合句则包含两个或多个分句，用连词连接。条件用if，让步用although/though，原因用because/so。注意标点：复合句中从句在前时，常用逗号隔开。
grammar.example: If you know anyone who can repair clothes, please ask them.

options: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
Although it was raining. We went for a walk.
Although it was raining, we went for a walk
answers: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: Although引导让步状语从句，后面主句前用逗号，且句子结尾用句号。
questions.evidence: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

options: I stayed home because I was tired.
I stayed home, because I was tired.
I stayed home because, I was tired.
answers: I stayed home because I was tired.
questions.explanation: because引导原因状语从句，通常主句和从句之间不用逗号。
questions.evidence: I stayed home because I was tired.

options: If you need help, ask me.
If you need help ask me.
If you need help. Ask me.
answers: If you need help, ask me.
questions.explanation: if条件从句在前时，后面主句前用逗号。
questions.evidence: If you need help, ask me.

options: She was tired, so she went to bed early.
She was tired so, she went to bed early.
She was tired. So she went to bed early.
answers: She was tired, so she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: so连接两个简单句表示结果，前面用逗号。
questions.evidence: She was tired, so she went to bed early.

speaking.part2: Describe a time when you fixed something or someone helped you fix something. You should say: what the item was, what was wrong with it, who fixed it, and how you felt about the result.
part3: Why do some people prefer to repair things rather than replace them?
What can governments do to encourage recycling?
Do you think repair cafés will become more common in the future?
How does consumer culture affect the environment?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 120 words) about a community event you would like to organise. Explain what the event is, why it is useful, and how you would invite people. Use at least one conditional sentence and one reason clause.
